public.text: Stakeholder engagement lists health programmes, finance, identity, and ICT ministries but does not explicitly include subnational authorities, private providers, professional bodies, civil society, patients, data-protection authorities, standards bodies, or implementers.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the stakeholder list and require context-specific stakeholder analysis covering decision authority, affected communities, data contributors, service operators, and groups at risk of exclusion.
